integrations.criterion: Valid registration and sign-in work; invalid details produce feedback.
integrations.steps: New test aliases. Register Afnan and Fajer; complete onboarding. Sign out; use Afnan's incorrect password, then correct credentials.
integrations.expected: Accounts open onboarding; incorrect sign-in rejected; retry opens authenticated discovery.
integrations.actual: Both accounts created; error shown; retry succeeded.
integrations.method: Manual interaction through the running Android UI

integrations.criterion: Skills, interests and availability can be saved and edited.
integrations.steps: Fajer authenticated. Save onboarding; open editors; change Kotlin to Advanced and add Education; save and view Passport.
integrations.expected: Updated skills and interests remain visible with saved availability.
integrations.actual: Advanced Kotlin, Education and 6 hours/week displayed.
integrations.method: Manual interaction through the running Android UI

integrations.criterion: Selected visibility is enforced for another viewer.
integrations.scenario: Unrelated student and applicant owner access
integrations.steps: Afnan selects Teams you apply to. Fajer opens Afnan's Passport. Fajer applies with the same visibility choice; Afnan reviews Fajer's Passport.
integrations.expected: Unrelated view restricted; the request owner sees the applicant's shared Passport.
integrations.actual: Afnan's content hidden from Fajer; Afnan saw Fajer's skill when reviewing.
integrations.method: Manual interaction through the running Android UI

integrations.criterion: Outcome, roles, commitment and positions are captured; templates editable; required fields validated.
integrations.scenario: Project form to published details and editor
integrations.steps: Afnan authenticated. Try empty publish; enter outcome; choose Mobile developer; change openings 1 to 2; choose 6 hours/4 weeks; publish; open Edit.
integrations.expected: Empty fields rejected; published details retain values; owner editor loads them.
integrations.actual: Validation shown; two vacancies and commitment retained; owner editor opened.
integrations.method: Manual interaction through the running Android UI

integrations.criterion: Event records source, organizer, dates, eligibility and team rules; publisher remains distinct.
integrations.steps: Afnan authenticated. Publish demo competition with required fields and 20-21 Oct dates; edit type to Hackathon; save and open details.
integrations.expected: Required data retained; publisher separate from organizer; type update shown.
integrations.actual: Competition published; same event saved as Hackathon with source and rules.
integrations.method: Manual interaction through the running Android UI

integrations.criterion: Request links to an event; roles, places, source and rules are visible.
integrations.steps: Published demo event exists. Choose Find teammates; use UI/UX template with one place; publish; open details and owner editor.
integrations.expected: Request retains actual event reference and recruitment details; relevant event rules visible.
integrations.actual: Published linked request showed event card, official source, rules and one vacancy; editor loaded.
integrations.method: Manual interaction through the running Android UI

integrations.criterion: Search and filters return matches; empty results are clear; saved listings can be retrieved and removed.
integrations.steps: Fajer authenticated; demo listings exist. Filter Projects; search Campus then unmatched text; apply Kotlin filter; save project; view Saved; remove it.
integrations.expected: Correct match/empty states; saved item retrievable and removable.
integrations.actual: Matching project, clear no-results state, skill-filter result and saved/removed states observed.
integrations.method: Manual interaction through the running Android UI

integrations.criterion: Application records contribution and availability; duplicate active applications prevented.
integrations.steps: Open project exists; Fajer has no application. Send blank pitch, then valid pitch with 6 hours/week. Reopen detail and Activity.
integrations.expected: Blank pitch rejected; valid submission Under review; UI offers Withdraw instead of another Apply.
integrations.actual: Minimum 20-character error; submission and Activity status shown; Apply absent. Direct duplicate requests untested.
integrations.method: Manual interaction through the running Android UI

integrations.criterion: Withdrawal changes status; closed requests do not accept new applications.
integrations.steps: Fajer shortlisted. Afnan closes project; Fajer confirms withdrawal; view detail and Activity.
integrations.expected: Withdrawn in history; Closed detail offers no new application action.
integrations.actual: Withdrawn history and disabled Closed action observed. Direct backend attempts untested.
integrations.method: Manual interaction through the running Android UI

integrations.criterion: Owner can shortlist/remove candidates; membership must remain unchanged.
integrations.steps: Fajer's application exists. Afnan reviews, shortlists, removes and shortlists again. Compare displayed vacancies and student status; inspect membership records.
integrations.expected: Status tracks changes; no membership created; team capacity unchanged.
integrations.actual: Status changes and student Shortlisted confirmed; UI counts unchanged. Membership records not inspected because Firebase testing is deferred.
integrations.method: Manual interaction through the running Android UI

integrations.requirement: US04, US05, US07 / FR05, FR06, FR09
integrations.criterion: Expired events are identified; linked recruitment must not invite applications after expiry.
integrations.scenario: Parent event expiry propagated to linked request UI
integrations.steps: Existing linked request. Afnan changes parent dates to 1-2 Oct; Fajer opens parent and request, then taps Apply.
integrations.expected: Parent marked ended; linked request closes or prevents entering application flow.
integrations.actual: Parent Event ended; linked request shows revised dates but Apply remains enabled and form opens. No application sent.
integrations.method: Manual interaction through the running Android UI

system.requirement: US03, US06, US07, US08 / FR04, FR07, FR09, FR10
system.criterion: An owner publishes recruitment; another student discovers and applies; the owner reviews and shortlists.
system.steps: Two dedicated accounts. Afnan publishes the Campus Collaboration project. Fajer discovers it and submits a contribution with 6 hours/week. Afnan signs in, opens applicants, reviews Fajer and shortlists. Fajer signs back in and checks Activity.
system.expected: Project discoverable; application visible to owner; shortlist state visible to student.
system.actual: All UI stages completed; Fajer's Activity displayed Shortlisted. This result covers the UI journey, not database membership or direct-request authorization.
system.method: Manual system test on Samsung SM-G960W
